The city of Pronthesus had learned about these people they ran into that there was a very odd city to their south east that the Sophons may have interest in due to the nature of it seeming like the technology that they used.

Something about the flow of Corgi felt 'off' to those aboard the ships of the city of Pronthesus. The magic seemed somewhat stronger yet unstable, almost as if Gaea sensed the need for this power to stop something.

It was decided that the whole city would trek to this odd town these Schryke spoke of.

Many gliders were made from the new designs Wexter had discovered and a city took flight, traveling as fast as they could because this new output of power worried them and, due to the timing made them think that maybe something at this city was necessary for whatever was about to happen.

This power lasted for three days, just long enough for the city to reach the odd town.

----------

As the Sophons entered the city, each received a vision. A vision of what this city's true purpose was and how to make this happen.

The Sophons poured into the insides of this once great ship and began working to quickly fix any problems that would hinder it's flight.

----------

As they finished, the ship began to light up. The leader of this city, Ragnak, made his way to the bridge of Spallix and ordered the assembled Sophons of what was going to happen.

They were going to fly this ship back to destroy the creature that was assaulting the Tree of Life. Then they would find where the portal at Raekson led to so that they might avenge his death. Lastly, they would see where this ship could take them in the skies.

----------

Those Sophons and Chlorans in the relief cam heard a loud droning sound off on the horizon and turned to look in it's direction.

Each person stopped what they were doing and watched in awe as the ship of Spallix flew high over the Tree of Life's burnt husk and a beam of what appeared to be light, and alongside it drops, came down upon the large beast that had been assaulting the Chlorans.

The large Ouroborous lashed out at the ship but, it was too far away and missed.

It was too late anyway.

The Ouroborous burned away along with it's army of Daemons.

Every Sentient being in the area was them teleported aboard the Spallix as it flew ever higher in it's search for the destruction described by the scout team.

Spotted.

The enormous ship began moving towards the mountain of Arsenal.

Bolts of light rained down upon the poor creature's corpse as well as Arsenal itself.

This area would become nothing more than a smoking crater for others to see.

No one would attack them without reason and not expect extreme consequences.

Another mountain was spotted sporting a ridiculous amount of spinning apparatuses.

One of it's inhabitants was teleported aboard and quickly dispatched seeing as it was, as they expected, a Deva.

This mountain too as well as it's surrounding walls were destroyed. Though Ragnak, feeling merciful left many alive and brought some aboard the ship so that they might know why this happened.

These Deva were secured well into holding cells.

Not well enough.

As the great ship left the atmosphere, fighting broke out from the Deva held. many began dying at their hands.

There was nothing to be done; the Sophons were too far away from Gaea to fight back and one by one they fell.

The ship was not repaired well enough for the travel they were attempting.

Fires broke out as conduits burst and corridors ripped open, exposing many to the cold void of space.

Nothing could be done.

The ship flew higher still.

One of the, now, four moons was before them.

The ship could not be stopped; too many sections and parts were broken and, the Sophons could no longer move.

Trapped in the very pieces of armor meant to protect them, helpless to watch as the angry Deva approached them and cut them down, helpless to watch as the corridor was ripped open and brethren sucked out, and helpless to watch as the Spallix quickly descended upon the moon.

Ragnak felt sorrow in his actions as he watched the looming moon grow ever closer. Sorrow at leaving the Great city of Pronthesus, sorrow at damning his brethren to die, sorrow at how harshly he had destroyed the Deva's home, and sorrow that he could not apologize to his brethren, the Chlora, and the Deva.

Ragnak closed his eyes and ordered the Chlora on the bridge with the Sophons to set the self destruct. The Chlora looked confused and asked what it was. Ragnak told them it was the three red buttons on the console to his right and that it was to slow the ship down for landing. The closes one reached down and pressed. A siren sounded and a countdown began. The Chlorans stood in confusion. Ragnak cried and chanted, "No Blood, No Bone, No Ash!" The other Sophons on the bridge slowly joined in; chanting louder and louder until the whole ship was reverberating with their voices. The Deva stopped their fighting, understanding what was happening and stood solemnly watching out of whatever window they could as the moon grew closer.

"THREE SECONDS"

Ragnak stopped chanting and silently whispered.

"No Blood"

"TWO SECONDS"

"No bone"

"ONE SECOND"

"No Ash"

The ship exploded beautifully. The engines expanded quietly spewing flames and debris out into the void. The hull slowly being ripped apart from the inside out, back to front. Fire engulfed the Sophons, Chlorans, and Deva alike, indiscriminately consuming them and bringing their souls to the Vortex of Souls Tempest had created for them. The fire reached the bridge and obliterated it, snuffing out the last life aboard.

From the ground, every single being looked up as a flash came from the moon and began splitting apart and falling to Gaea.
